title: Publish v0.17.4: tenant-scoped user import, duplicate-key conflicts, and idempotent role grants
goal: Publish the IAM residual fixes merged in PR #417 (a9fffac8) as v0.17.4 so the next consumable asset carries them. User CSV import lookups are tenant-scoped and created users are stamped with the request tenant plus an active membership in the same transaction; CreateUser, CreateRole and UpdateRole map duplicate-key losers to the existing 409; tenant role permission and menu grants use batch ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; and the bootstrap backfill joins system_role for tenant ownership, excludes soft-deleted roles and deduplicates by natural key. No schema change (stays at 29), no route, permission code, menu seed or error-envelope shape change. The only response change is that the race loser sees 409 instead of 500.
findings: F-1 (P1, fixed in a9fffac8): loadUserImportLookups built four maps (same-name user, role key, department path, post code) over the whole database, and the create path wrote no tenant_id and no membership. A tenant-A import could update tenant B's same-named user; created users landed in the platform namespace, invisible to the importer and unable to log in.

F-2 (P2, fixed in a9fffac8): CreateUser, CreateRole and UpdateRole pre-check the natural key but the check is not atomic. The loser of a concurrent create or rename hit the UNIQUE index and surfaced MySQL 1062 as a 500 with the driver message.

F-3 (P2, fixed in a9fffac8): grantTenantRolePermissions and grantTenantRoleMenus inserted one row at a time after a read, so two concurrent repair runs that both missed a key failed the second writer.

F-4 (P2, fixed in a9fffac8): backfillRolePermissions selected system_role_menu without joining the owning role, so tenant-role permission rows were stamped tenant_id = 0, and a permission key exposed by several menus was seeded once per menu.
F-5 (P3, documentation): the v0.17.3 notes still described system_role_data_scope as read-then-write. The published notes are immutable; the correction is recorded forward in v0.17.4.

in: Tenant-scoped user import lookups; imported users stamped from the request context with an active membership in the same transaction
Duplicate-key losers in CreateUser, CreateRole and UpdateRole mapped to the existing 409 conflicts
Idempotent batch permission and menu grants with clause.OnConflict{DoNothing:true}
Bootstrap backfill joins system_role for tenant ownership, excludes soft-deleted roles and deduplicates by natural key
Real-MySQL regressions for all four paths
Version material: VERSION 0.17.4, CHANGELOG, RELEASE_NOTES_v0.17.4.md, README(zh/en), STATUS
Publish pantheon-base-v0.17.4 with the four foundation-release assets
out: Any further production runtime logic change; the fixes were merged in PR #417
Routes, permission codes, menu seeds and error-envelope shapes
Rewriting the published v0.17.0 through v0.17.3 tags and assets
Relaxing gate thresholds, skipping tests or using suppressions

acceptanceCriteria: User import resolves username, role key, department path and post code inside the caller's tenant, and created users carry the request tenant plus an active membership.
A duplicate-key loser in CreateUser, CreateRole or UpdateRole returns the existing 409 conflict, and exactly one row survives on the contested key.
Permission and menu grants converge under a repeat run; a manually deleted grant is restored without duplicating the rest.
Backfill stamps the owning role's tenant, produces nothing for soft-deleted roles, inserts one row per natural key and is a no-op on a repeat run.
Full backend suite passes against real MySQL/Redis with both required flags set; go build, go vet and gofmt are clean.
Governance checkers pass: docs frontmatter, task packet, structure, generated modules, failure registry.
Release Gate Summary is successful on the merge commit before the release is cut.
pantheon-base-v0.17.4 is an annotated tag carrying tgz / tgz.sha256 / repo.tar / repo.tar.sha256; checksums and Foundation Release Verify are green.
The published release is not a draft or prerelease, and gh release view reports exactly the four assets.

doNotTouch: the published v0.17.0, v0.17.1, v0.17.2 and v0.17.3 tags and assets

implementationNotes: The four fixes merged in PR #417 (a9fffac8) on top of the v0.17.3 tag; this packet only publishes them and adds version material.
cut-foundation-release.mjs does not read RELEASE_NOTES_*.md automatically; --release-notes, --upgrade-notes and --consumer-impact must be passed explicitly.
The release gate is a hard precondition: publish-foundation-release.mjs refuses to continue unless the latest Release Gate Summary check-run on the target commit succeeded.
The local TSan runtime cannot start on this Windows host (shadow-memory allocation error 87); race coverage is left to CI on Linux.
The published v0.17.3 notes are immutable; the stale system_role_data_scope sentence is corrected forward in v0.17.4.

release: gh release view pantheon-base-v0.17.4 --repo duanxldragon/pantheon-base --json assets,tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease
